testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a staged classic context-menu setting: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1969:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a staged classic context-menu setting ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab in the MCAD Software ✔ And "Use Classic Context Menu" is unchecked ✔ And no customization change is pending ✔ When the user checks "Use Classic Context Menu" ✔ Then the option is checked ✔ And "OK", "Cancel" and "Apply" are available ✔ When the user clicks "Cancel" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ When the user reopens customization on the Marking Menu tab ✔ Then "Use Classic Context Menu" is unchecked ✔ And no customization change is pending
